data.question: Berapa APM SMA di Jawa Timur?

value.raw_question: Berapa APM SMA di Jawa Timur?

value.sql:
SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, periode, AVG(nilai) AS nilai
FROM nilai_indikator
LEFT JOIN provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.nama, periode
ORDER BY nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.nama AS wilayah, T2.periode, T2.nilai
FROM provinsi AS T1
JOIN nilai_indikator AS T2
ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
WHERE T2.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND T2.periode = :periode
  AND T2.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)

AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.kode
ORDER BY nilai DESC
